summary_md:
# Börsen mot tydlig uppgång – Asienexperten om turbulensen

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is an EFN Morgon episode recorded on Thanksgiving, with the Stockholm market opening sharply higher after extreme AI-driven volatility on Wall Street. Guest Joel Forsberg of Amos fonder says he buys on dips using a fixed fair-value framework. He holds Revolution Race over New Wave, owns Avanza, Nordea, Trygg and quality property companies, which he sees as cheap at about 10x förvaltningsresultat, and reads Note's sudden CEO exit as a sign of a weak quarter. The episode also covers Asia and new US tariffs on China with Katherine Young, Nvidia's chip-export controversy, the SKF/Vertevo spin-off going ex-dividend, and Lindab's CEO on spare capacity and high electricity prices in SE4.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 RVRC — Revolution Race | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Amos holds a much larger position in RVRC than in New Wave. RVRC grew 43% in Sweden, may see a German catch-up, and trades at a lower valuation.

#### Reasoning

Guest Joel Forsberg (Amos fonder) owns a significantly larger position in RVRC than in New Wave. Core-market Sweden grew 43% last quarter. If Germany's problems resolve, a similar catch-up there gives 'tickling potential'. The valuation is lower than New Wave's. He cautions against reading too much into one quarter.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Swedish growth reverses in coming quarters
- if German problems persist
- if valuation re-rates above fair value

> *"just nu är det ju fördel Revolution Race tycker jag. Och dessutom handlas den till en lägre värdering."*

---

### 🟡 NEWA-B — New Wave | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest likes and owns New Wave, but as a smaller position. Negative growth in Sweden is worrying.

#### Reasoning

Guest says 'vi gillar ju båda' but holds a much smaller New Wave position. Negative Swedish growth was surprising, and CEO Torsten Jansson had no good explanation. Not every sale is to consumers, but the failure to grow is concerning.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Swedish sales keep declining
- if management cannot explain weakness

> *"Men att de ändå inte klarar av att växa, det är ändå oroväckande."*

---

### ⛔ NOTE — Note | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

CEO left with immediate effect and the CFO is leaving soon. Guest suspects a weak quarter and sees the promised record Q4 as shaky.

#### Reasoning

Guest calls the CEO exit 'inget bra besked', a sign Note is not performing well this quarter. Q3 cash flow was weak despite promises of improvement, and the record-Q4 guidance now 'hänger löst'. The CFO not leaving the same day softens it somewhat. Stock fell 4.5% at the open.

> *"Det är inget bra besked. Det är ett tecken på att Note inte presterar särskilt bra det här kvartalet."*

---

### 🟡 AZA — Avanza | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

The fund owns Avanza and calls it long-term attractive, a 'self-playing piano'. It may trim if the stock rallies on Q4.

#### Reasoning

Avanza benefits from the extreme Nvidia trading activity, but a one-off EPS bump deserves only a low multiple. Long term, Avanza earns money as markets rise, as long as its products are OK. Guest would consider scaling down on a Q4-driven rally.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the stock rallies sharply on Q4 beyond fair value
- if product quality slips

> *"långsiktigt är Avanza också ett väldigt attraktivt bolag som tjänar pengar egentligen bara för att börsen går upp"*

---

### 🟡 NDA-SE — Nordea | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Bank position added as a cheap case and as a hedge against rising rates for the property holdings.

#### Reasoning

Guest added banks, including Nordea, as a 'billigt bra case' and a hedge against rate risk in property holdings. They have not made money since July, but he sees low downside risk. Nordea could be trimmed in relative rebalancing.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall and the hedge is no longer needed
- if more discounted cyclical opportunities appear

> *"Då adderade vi lite bank som ett billigt bra case men också kanske lite som en hedge."*

---

### 🟡 TRYG — Trygg | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Holding that has contributed to the fund's outperformance since July.

#### Reasoning

The host says Trygg contributed to returns, and the guest names it as a possible trim candidate for funding more cyclical names after a fall.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin of safety to fair value disappears

> *"Ska vi minska i ett Trygg som du nämnde eller Nordea kanske för att köpa mer är det något som har fallit mer"*

---

### 🟠 CORE-B — Corem | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Asset sales at book value are a positive signal and reduce risk for a highly leveraged company. The guest does not own it and prefers quality property names.

#### Reasoning

Selling at book value shows the NAV discount may not be justified, and raising capital lowers leverage risk. The guest prefers more stable, high-quality property companies and admits he follows Corem poorly.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further sales come in below book value
- if leverage stays high

> *"de är väldigt högt skuldsatta så att de kan få in kapital och kanske minska den risken är väldigt positivt"*
